summary:
DIAGNOSE ONLY (no code changes) — Formatting toolbar active-state highlighting in NoteModal. Verified via Playwright on desktop 1280x900. The highlight pipeline (refreshActive → setActive → isToolActive → data-active='true' + ring-2 ring-orange-500 bg-orange-500/15) works correctly for every INLINE format (bold/italic/underline/strike) and for every BLOCK format (P/H1/H2/H3) WHEN the caret sits inside a proper block element. The user-visible 'missing highlight' happens on lines that are BARE TOP-LEVEL TEXT NODES in the contenteditable (no P/H1/H2/H3 wrapper, separated by
). The DOM shape itself is produced by the H1/promote-block operation, not by the active-state detector.
verdict: Active-state highlight code is CORRECT by its own contract; upstream block-promote operation leaves bare text nodes which the detector (correctly, per its design) refuses to classify as any block → no block button lights up for those lines.

verified_working.bold: Caret inside <b>/<strong> → data-active=true; outside → false. Class 'ring-2 ring-orange-500 bg-orange-500/15' applied.
verified_working.italic: Caret inside <i>/<em> → true (also stacks when inside H1: italic=true AND h1=true).
verified_working.p/h1/h2/h3: Mutually exclusive, only the block matching active.block lights up. Toggle P↔H1↔H2↔H3 reflects immediately.
verified_working.selection_sync: document-level 'selectionchange', 'focusin', and 'input' (rAF-deferred) listeners all fire; state updates within ~1 frame.
verified_working.textarea_shortcut: When editor is a TEXTAREA (plaintext mode before first format click), refreshActive short-circuits to all-false (lines 1976-1980) — intentional, no inline markup to detect.

root_cause_of_user_observed_bug.symptom: P / H1 / H2 / H3 toolbar buttons do NOT highlight when the caret is on a line that looks like a normal paragraph.
root_cause_of_user_observed_bug.where_in_dom:
The 'line' is a bare Text node whose parentElement === the contenteditable root (no

/ ancestor between the text and the editor).
root_cause_of_user_observed_bug.where_in_code: /app/frontend/src/notes/editor/FloatingRichTextToolbar.jsx :: refreshActive() lines 1999-2036. The ancestor walk is `let node = range.startContainer; if (TEXT_NODE) node = node.parentElement; while (node && node !== editor) { ...detect P/H1/H2/H3... }`. For bare top-level text, parentElement IS the editor, so the loop body never executes → block stays null → NO block button highlights.
root_cause_of_user_observed_bug.why_this_dom_shape_exists:
The block-promote operation that applied H1 to 'Alpha' did NOT wrap the surrounding sibling text in

. It emitted

Alpha


Beta
Gamma

— bare text +
. This is the real upstream defect. Also seen after applying P:

Alpha


Beta

Gamma

(only the targeted line got wrapped; the other bare siblings stayed bare).
root_cause_of_user_observed_bug.scope: Affects NoteModal.jsx HTML editor (data-testid=note-content-input-html). Same refreshActive logic lives on FullScreenNote 'format' mode (data-testid=fullscreen-content-input-format) — same symptom will manifest there if the same DOM shape appears.

recommended_minimal_fix_for_main_agent:
PREFERRED (fixes root cause): in the block-promote/applyBlock pipeline that handles H1/H2/H3/P, after mutating the targeted line, scan the editor's direct childNodes and wrap any bare Text node (and any orphan
-delimited text run) in a

. This normalizes the editor to 'every top-level content lives in a block element', which (a) lets refreshActive classify every caret position, (b) makes alignment/list operations deterministic, (c) prevents the empty

sentinels that currently bracket the content.

SECONDARY (defensive, 1-line patch in refreshActive at ~L2036 after the walk): `if (block === null && editor.contains(range.startContainer) && !findAlignBlockAncestor(editor, range.startContainer)) block = 'P';` — treats implicit paragraph context as P so the P button lights up even for bare text. Caveat: this masks the real DOM-shape bug and may give false confidence; prefer the structural fix above and keep refreshActive honest.
DO NOT remove the TEXTAREA short-circuit (lines 1976-1980) — plaintext mode genuinely has no markup to detect; first-click swap-to-HTML behavior relies on it.
additional_minor_findings: First click on any format button in a brand-new (empty-content) note swaps textarea → contenteditable; this is correct but means the user never sees any 'pre-click' active-state in a fresh note (expected).
Toolbar portal z-index 2147483000 and `pointerEvents: auto` on container confirmed; no overlay interception observed.
Fix G (break ancestor walk on first block boundary) is in effect — confirmed italic inside H1 does NOT falsely report bold from a stale <strong> wrapper above.

`active.aa`, `active.hl`, `active.align` paths were not exercised to a 'true' state in this run (require opening the Aa/Highlight/Align sub-panels and picking a value); worth a follow-up pass but detector logic for them mirrors the inline-span class scan at L2008-2013 and the block-class scan at L2028-2032, which looked correct on code review.

ui_bugs.issue:

action_items:
Main agent: normalize editor top-level children to block elements inside the applyBlock pipeline (wrap bare Text nodes in

, remove the empty

sentinels at start/end). This is the precise minimal correction the user asked for.
Optionally add the 1-line defensive fallback in refreshActive to default `block='P'` when no block ancestor is found inside the editor.
critical_code_review_comments: FloatingRichTextToolbar.jsx L1999-2036: refreshActive is clean, O(ancestor-depth), and correctly stops at block boundaries (Fix G). Its only blind spot is bare top-level text nodes, which should not exist if applyBlock normalized output.
L2048-2054: setActive uses structural-equality guard — avoids re-renders when state hasn't changed. Good.
L2063-2095: useEffect wires `selectionchange`, `focusin`, `input` (capture, rAF-deferred). Priming call at L2089 ensures correct state on reopen. Teardown clean.
L3244-3290: button renders `data-active` and the orange ring/bg classes correctly. `t.accent` fallback for non-highlightable tools preserved.

NoteModal.jsx L129 `isHtml = looksLikeHtml(content)` is read every render — fine, but the textarea→HTML swap on first format click means `refreshActive` can briefly target a stale TEXTAREA until the next render. In practice the input/selectionchange cascade re-reads findActiveEditor so this is self-correcting.

success_rate.frontend: Active-state code: PASS for inline (B/I/U/S) and block-when-wrapped (P/H1/H2/H3). Edge case FAIL for bare top-level text — root cause is applyBlock DOM output, not refreshActive.

rca_of_the_issue:
FloatingRichTextToolbar.refreshActive (L1999-2036) requires caret to live under a P/H1/H2/H3 element to classify a block. The applyBlock operation that converts a selected line to H1 does not wrap the surrounding sibling lines in

— they remain as bare Text nodes separated by
. Caret placed in those bare lines → no block ancestor → no block button highlights. Precise minimal fix: normalize the editor's top-level children to block elements inside applyBlock (wrap bare text in

, drop empty

sentinels).
